name: Hoco O Tag Intelligent Positioning Anti-Lost Device E96A Busca – Support Google Find My Network [Suitable for Android]
description:
Hoco E96A Busca O Tag Smart Tracker for Android – Find Your Essentials with Confidence 🔑
What it is

The Hoco E96A Busca O Tag Smart Tracker is a compact Bluetooth tracker that integrates seamlessly with the Google Find My Device network. Whether it’s keys, wallets, backpacks, or even your pet’s collar, this tracker helps you locate what matters most—quickly and reliably.

Powered by Google Find My Device

Connects directly to Google’s Find My Device app.

Leverages millions of Android devices worldwide for real-time location tracking.

Simple setup with your Google account.

⚠️ Not supported in Mainland China, North Korea, Cuba, Iran, Russia, and Ukraine due to network restrictions.

Sleek & Lightweight Design

Material: Durable ABS plastic

Size: 32 × 32 × 7 mm

Weight: 7.5 g

Minimalist profile—fits on keychains, wallets, backpacks, luggage, or collars.

Long-Lasting Replaceable Battery

Powered by CR2032 coin cell (210 mAh)

Lifespan: 6–8 months under normal use

Easily replaceable—no recharging required

Wide Android Compatibility

Works with 90%+ Android smartphones that support Google Play Store

Easy setup:

Check phone compatibility with Google Find My Device.

Download the Find My Device app.

Pair your Hoco E96A via Bluetooth and link it to your Google account.

Key Features at a Glance

✔️ Google Find My Device integration
✔️ Global tracking via Android network
✔️ Ultra-compact & lightweight build
✔️ Replaceable long-life battery
✔️ Broad Android compatibility
